steps: Fix the underlying cause first (usually a leak) before patching.
Lightly mist the damaged texture area with water and scrape it off.
Apply joint compound to smooth the area, feathering the edges.
Once dry and sanded, use a popcorn-texture spray to match the surrounding ceiling.
Prime and paint the patched area if it doesn't blend after texturing.
